prompt: restore a clean, uniform normal metallic borescope surface; preserve realistic metal texture and lighting
execution: single GPU sequential; no search/retry/download; no implicit crop; padding_mask_crop=None
residual_factors: internal noise schedule differs despite equal numerical seed/strength/guidance

input_rules.crop: L=min(W,H); integer half-open box inside native; clamp center origin to feasible interval containing ALL target polygons plus margin
input_rules.tie_rule: center origin=floor((dimension-L)/2); clamp independently on x/y
input_rules.raster: Pillow ImageDraw polygon round(x),round(y), union of ALL target-class polygons
input_rules.common: identical square crop; RGB LANCZOS->512; grayscale edit mask NEAREST->512
input_rules.sdxl: common RGB LANCZOS->1024; common mask NEAREST->1024; no padding
input_rules.mask_polarity: white=edit, black=preserve; gray=feather (pipeline mask binarization separately disclosed)
input_rules.semantic_gate: whole square UI/FOV/gray border; real normal-metal continuity; physical edge crossing; unannotated defects; all PENDING unless explicit new review
input_rules.rejection: pairwise exclusion, no replacement/target reduction/relaxation; >=4 sources and >=2 per class plus semantic review required
